patches.name: Account location badges
patches.description: Shows X-Posed style country badges next to names, in profile and chat headers, and highlights or hides posts from chosen countries, without reporting passive engagement with them. Data comes from the X-Posed community cache, falling back to X's "About this account". Tap a badge for account details and settings. Posts can be shared as images.
